notes.content:
Improvements

Implemented keyboard control functionality.
Corrected some grammar errors. Thanks to @Crash [LV] for the feedback.

Resolved an issue with the ghost ship displaying incorrectly in certain languages.

notes.title: Version 1.2.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
Balance Adjustments
[olist]
 Alien now summons a robot assistant while removing itself.
 Demon Hunter earns more coins after upgrading.
 The Programmer's production boost has been changed from 4 to 3.
[/olist]
Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the coin animation wouldn't disappear after restarting the game in the middle.
 Fixed additional production issues caused by the salesperson.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.2.6 Release Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
 Resolved the issue where birth and settlement animations couldn't be accelerated.
 Fixed the problem with incorrect coin rewards when the police remove criminals.
 Addressed the issue where the Wiki couldn't display character upgrade information.
 Fixed the problem where the Shopaholic item wasn't functioning correctly.
 Optimized the calculation of special abilities for band members and ghosts through levels, no longer counted separately.
 Added characters offering item removal services.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733476/0cf78e725904bed8801c03faa2ab8910a857f1c2.png

notes.title: 1.2.5 Release Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
 In Casual Mode, you can now directly complete the game when you have enough coins. 
 Addressed an issue where the game could potentially crash upon closing.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.2.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
 Added a button to modify animation speed during gameplay.
 Introduced a statistical UI panel.
 Corrected some translation errors in the text.
 Addressed an issue where some animations were not applying speed settings.
[/olist]
